statements.t: In the fourth quarter, we expect to sell $1.5 million of RINs generated from third quarter biodiesel production and to recover $2.3 million in derivative losses tied to the corresponding sale of physical inventory.

Further, we expect demand to strengthen entering 2027, as recent regulatory changes narrow the RIN-equivalence advantage previously enjoyed by renewable diesel producers and improve the competitive position of biodiesel producers like FutureFuel.
We expect to begin initial production batches with this customer in the first quarter of 2027 and to reach full production rates by mid-2027.

We will continue to prioritize customer-funded investments at Batesville and the working capital needed to support feedstock purchases, while maintaining flexibility for opportunistic share repurchases, subject to business conditions and available liquidity, together with the continued payment of our quarterly cash dividend.

We expect full-year 2026 capital expenditures of $25.8 million, including $10.2 million of customer-funded growth investments, and more than $26 million of customer-funded growth investments in 2027 as customer demand for additional Batesville capacity remains high.”
We currently expect fourth quarter Adjusted EBITDA of approximately $7 million, positioning us to deliver positive Adjusted EBITDA for the full-year 2026.
Importantly, we do not anticipate major planned maintenance at Batesville through the first quarter of 2027.
Following recent capacity expansions and de-bottlenecking activities, the Company anticipates fourth quarter Chemicals segment level capacity utilization above prior-year levels.
The following forward-looking guidance reflects the Company’s current expectations and beliefs as of November 9, 2026, and is subject to change.
